steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Meteorite...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What exactly did Jessica see...? Were you with her?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...It's better if you don't find out.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It has nothing to do with our combat operations... so don't worry about it right now.
How long are you going to keep hiding, Rhodes Island insects?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (...! Mephisto! Did he find us?)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Don't make any noises. Not yet. It's just another one of his tricks.)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Aww, still don't feel like coming out?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't think I didn't see your reinforcements coming.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Well, whatever. I have something to show you. I'm sure you'll like it.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Looking back now... We were originally planning to take over Chernobog from the very beginning...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: We waited for so, so long... and finally our time has come...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The moment when we take our revenge against Ursus! Against those who persecuted us Infected!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But, what about the fellows in this sub-city?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They ran away.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They had pretty quick reactions. Ran away before we had a chance to take action.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Disconnected themselves, and took off as quickly as they could--

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But where did they hope to escape to?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Our comrades had long permeated every district, waiting for our opportunity.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: In the end, we caught up to them, and gave them the punishment they deserved.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: These cowards, these perpetrators; what were we to do with them?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It's simple - we would make an example of them!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: A proclamation that all injustices against the Infected would be purged...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...Yes, that is the symbol of the Reunion Movement...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Let them all turn into effigies of terror, one by one!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You, set that nearby effigy on fire! Let there be light!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Come, light up this entire city! Let Rhodes Island see what happens to all of these cowardly oppressors!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: (--Don't!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...? !

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's... a burning hellscape of malevolence and madness...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, let go of me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...No, you must let me see it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: One day, I must hold him accountable for his actions. Besides, I used to...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why... Why...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Jessica, calm down.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: --That bastard!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...This is too atrocious...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The smell of burning flesh...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: How long to you intend to keep hiding, my dear rabbit of Chernobog?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I saw your little rabble sneaking around earlier, so I thought you might've been up to something.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But turns out, you're just here to enjoy the show... How boring.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Looks like you brought an entire party with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did you do all this?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Of course~

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Without using some terror tactics, how else were we supposed to minimize the losses?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Make an example out of these ten percent...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ...and the other ninety percent fall into line.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: This, you see, can be considered the best way of saving lives.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I am not the same person I was back then..

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even though you might not remember...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... Back then, I was timid, fragile, and easily scared... I couldn't move forward without you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I might even look the same way right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the difference is, I've now seen more than enough tragedies.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want to see something like this happen ever again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...But nothing will change unless I face reality!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, I have to remind myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't afford to retreat...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have to continue to fight on!
